name: Northern Mariana Islands
officialName: Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

flag.description: A blue field with a large white five-pointed star in front of a gray latte stone, encircled by a wreath of flowers.
flag.symbolism: The white star represents the United States, the latte stone the Chamorro people, and the flower wreath (mwarmwar) the Carolinian people.

hook: The Northern Marianas put a white star on a gray stone pillar inside a ring of flowers; Guam has a red border and its name in red letters instead.
trivia: Latte stones are stone pillars topped with cup-shaped capstones that once raised ancient Chamorro houses off the ground.
The flower wreath was added in 1985; the earlier flag showed only the star and the latte stone.
